about: The points on the page's map of gated neighborhoods, north to south, one numbered marker each. A map of many places shows 15 at most (tools/area-map.js), so four pairs of neighbors that share a road share a marker. Points are the average position of the community's home address points (Horry County) or home parcel centers (Georgetown County) from gated-communities.json; a pair is the midpoint of its two points (each pair is under 1.5 km apart). Round 2 (2026-10-13): the page draws two maps, the places with an area other than pawleys-island on the first and 'pawleys' (each neighborhood its own marker) on the second.

prices.about: The price chart (round 2): the typical (middle) recorded sale for each gated neighborhood with a front gate whose verified row allows one, rounded as the page says it. Leatherleaf and The Bluffs on the Waterway (ranges only) and Myrtle Trace (back gate only) are said in the text; Georgetown County rows are not used. Round 5: the seven Georgetown County neighborhoods use MLS closed sales of detached homes in the same 12 months (ledger rows 83 to 89, pending verification), because the county's sales server refuses connections.
